security_implications: This chunk routes TL-UL transactions based on reg_steer; incorrect steering could allow an attacker to access HMAC registers instead of the window or vice versa, violating intended access controls. The error output, intg_err_o, is a raw OR of several fault signals and may directly feed alert logic; false positives or missed errors can affect system security response. Hardwired integrity generation (u_rsp_intg_gen) ensures TL response integrity is always applied, which is a positive security property. However, the zero-depth socket forces a tight timing assumption; violation could cause loss of transactions, possibly leading to denial-of-service or partial state updates.
